rows.line: Apple's device service is installed (Apple Devices app)

apple_devices.hint: After you sign in to Windows, Apple Devices can take a few minutes to start. CellGlide also tries to start it in the background; if the iPhone still isn't found, open Apple Devices.

rows.line: wintun.dll is missing or its signature isn't valid
rows.fix: run the installation command again in PowerShell: irm https://pkg.cellglide.com/install.ps1 | iex

rows.line: Couldn't check whether another program is using DNS port 53 (access denied)
rows.fix: run the check again; if it still can't check, restart the computer
